title: Azadi (Shahyad) Tower
standfirst: Marble-clad monument inaugurated in October 1971, designed by Hossein Amanat.

facts.label: Evidence note
facts.value: Currently inauguration day differs by source.

body.text: Designed by Hossein Amanat, whose entry was chosen in a national competition announced in September 1966; originally the Shahyad Aryamehr Monument, renamed Azadi after 1979[@hemmati2015].
Inaugurated at sunset on 16 October 1971 as part of the celebrations (one thesis, citing the contemporary press; other accounts may give 17 October)[@hemmati2015].
